description: A small, crowded kitchen at night, lit by fairy lights. On the counter stands a row of glass bottles filled with water to different levels, and a laughing young woman in a rust jumper taps them with a spoon to play notes. Next to her a young man in a white shirt drums on cooking pots with wooden spoons. Behind them a young woman blows across the top of a bottle, and friends crowd round clapping and smiling. A man in a blue shirt watches from the doorway with his arms crossed and then covers his face.
